init_ACGANCriterion: create an ACGANCriterion instance with an attribKeysOrder dictionary defining attribute categories and their possible values
generateConstraintsFromVector: generate one-hot constraint tensors from a labels dictionary for a given batch size
buildRandomCriterionTensor: build random criterion tensors with random combinations of attribute class values for a batch
buildLatentCriterion: build a one-hot latent criterion tensor from a target category tensor
getCriterion: compute the conditional cross-entropy loss between the discriminator output and target labels
